title: Contract C5: the variables document
description: The data of ConfigMap flux-system/sovereign-variables, one per region cluster. Every value is a string. The keys listed in docs/contracts/c5-kit-keys.txt are kit keys: they are removed before this schema is applied, so a document holds exactly the keys below plus kit keys. Cross-field rules 1 to 7 are enforced by the Go package core/controllers/pkg/upstream (FromMap and Validate) and by scripts/check-variables-documents.sh.

SOVEREIGN_MODE.description: mothership turns on the provisioning routes, the wizard and the pool-domain manager.

SOVEREIGN_CONSUME.description: origin: chart, kit and package sources and the node fallback read the origin registry. local: they read this region's own registry only. The flip sets local.

HANDOVER_AUTO.description: Start the hand-over flip without a person once the phase is HandedOver. Replaces the module input fire_cutover_on_handover.

HANDOVER_HOLD_SECONDS.description: Length of the deny-egress hold, in seconds. Allowed range 30 to 3600 (cross-field rule 6).

REGISTRY_HOST.description: Host and optional port that chart, kit and package sources use, no scheme. Equals ORIGIN_REGISTRY_HOST while SOVEREIGN_CONSUME is origin and LOCAL_REGISTRY_HOST when it is local.

REGISTRY_SCHEME.description: Scheme for REGISTRY_HOST. http is allowed only while SOVEREIGN_CONSUME is origin.

LOCAL_REGISTRY_HOST.description: This region's own registry host as nodes and pods resolve it. Example: registry.alpha.example.org.

ORIGIN_REGISTRY_HOST.description: The parent's registry host and optional port. Empty is allowed only with SOVEREIGN_CONSUME local (a Sovereign fed by offline bundles).

ORIGIN_REGISTRY_CA_B64.description: Base64 PEM of the origin registry's certificate authority. Empty: public trust.

ORIGIN_PROXY_ENDPOINTS_JSON.description: Transitional. JSON object: canonical registry name to a full endpoint address that replaces the origin endpoint for that name. Exists only so the present mothership can reproduce its two-port mirror. Removed by SOV-940.

REGISTRY_PULL_SECRET.description: Name of the dockerconfigjson Secret in flux-system.

REGISTRY_PATH_CHARTS.description: Project path of Helm charts. Sources render oci://${REGISTRY_HOST}/${REGISTRY_PATH_CHARTS}.

REGISTRY_PATH_RELEASE.description: Repository path that holds catalyst-bom and catalyst-kit.

REGISTRY_PATH_PROVIDER_PACKS.description: One repository per cloud beneath it.

REGISTRY_PATH_XPKG.description: Path of Crossplane packages. A package address is ${REGISTRY_HOST}/${REGISTRY_PATH_XPKG}/<org>/<name>@sha256:<digest>. Equal to the proxy project of xpkg.upbound.io, so one copy serves both the package manager and the nodes.

REGISTRY_PATH_TOFU_PROVIDERS.description: Path of the OpenTofu provider mirror. The mirror address is ${REGISTRY_HOST}/${REGISTRY_PATH_TOFU_PROVIDERS}.

REGISTRY_PATH_NODE_ARTIFACTS.description: Path of node artifacts: k3s binary, k3s image archive, install script, Flux install manifest, Gateway API manifest.

REGISTRY_PATH_VULN_DB.description: Repository path, without a tag, of the vulnerability database of the scanner (Trivy) on this region's own registry. The scanner reads ${LOCAL_REGISTRY_HOST}/${REGISTRY_PATH_VULN_DB}. The first segment is the proxy project that pulls the database through from the origin registry; the rest is the path of the database there. A parent serves its child proxy-vulndb/ followed by its own value. The default is the path for the origin registry ghcr.io.

REGISTRY_PROXY_PROJECTS_JSON.description: JSON object: canonical registry name to the project path that serves it on every registry in the chain. An empty path means the registry serves that name at its root. The key set is the closed list of names a node may pull from.

RELEASE_PUBLIC_KEY_B64.description: Base64 PEM of the cosign public key that signs the bill of materials and the kit artifact. The trust root handed down by the parent.

RELEASE_VERSION.description: Exact version to run. Empty: follow the local channel tag.

RELEASE_AUTO.description: true lets release-sync move the local channel tag.

RELEASE_SYNC_SCHEDULE.description: Cron expression (UTC) of the release-sync CronJob.

ORIGIN_PARENT_FQDN.description: Parent Sovereign name. Empty on a root Sovereign.

ORIGIN_PARENT_API_URL.description: Base address of the parent API. Used only for the release call.

DNS_MODE.description: delegated: this Sovereign's PowerDNS is authoritative for its zones. upstream-managed keeps the central path and makes the proof fail.

DNS_UPSTREAM_API_URL.description: Read only when DNS_MODE is upstream-managed.

MAIL_MODE.description: local: the local mail Blueprint. relay: SMTP submission to MAIL_RELAY_HOST. none: sign-in by mail is off.

MAIL_RELAY_SECRET.description: Name of a Secret in catalyst-system with keys smtp-user and smtp-pass, issued for this Sovereign only.

K3S_VERSION.description: Target k3s version of every node in this region.

K3S_UPGRADE_CONCURRENCY.description: Agents upgraded at once. Servers are always one at a time.

CLOUD_CREDENTIAL_MODE.description: How this Sovereign obtains its own cloud identity. The parent takes the default from the cloud profile field spec.identity.mode; supplied is always allowed.

CLOUD_CREDENTIAL_ROTATION_NONCE.description: Changing this value requests one rotation now.

GITOPS_REPO_URL.description: Git address from which provider-opentofu fetches provider-pack modules (contract C6). Always inside the Sovereign. The revision is not in this document: it is GITOPS_REVISION in ConfigMap flux-system/sovereign-release, delivered by the release.
